business_problem: Localiza needed to increase employee productivity and optimize repetitive manual tasks.
solution_summary: Localiza built its Microsoft solution to improve employee-productivity and operational workflows. Localiza needed to increase employee productivity and optimize repetitive manual tasks. Key components included Microsoft 365 Copilot delivered dashboards, apps, or copilots to users, and Microsoft Copilot Studio coordinated workflows, prompts, or deployment. User prompts and domain content are orchestrated through Microsoft Copilot Studio, processed by Microsoft Copilot Studio, and then delivered through Microsoft 365 Copilot so Localiza can return context-aware answers or automation in the flow of work. The governed Microsoft stack gave Localiza a reusable foundation for generative ai / llm, contact center while keeping deployment, security, and day-to-day operations inside the Microsoft estate. Localiza reduced 8.3 working hours per employee per month, improved inclusivity, and increased productivity in key areas of the company.
